final: SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(x.client_count) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(1.0 * x.client_count / SUM(x.client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3)) AS avg_district_share FROM district AS d JOIN (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client GROUP BY district_id) AS x ON x.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3
